damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons

traits.name: Stone Camouflage
traits.description: The grick has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in rocky terrain.

multiattack_text: The grick makes one attack with its tentacles. If that attack hits, the grick can make one beak attack against the same target.

attacks.name: Tentacles
attacks.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) slashing damage.

attacks.name: Beak
attacks.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.
